Hi there, and thanks so much for contacting Leafy! 🌿

Leafy Plus is **$59 per year**, and it auto-renews.

Here's what you get with it:
- Free Standard shipping with no minimum order
- Free change-of-mind returns (normally $6.95)
- A 90-day Plant Care Guarantee instead of 30 days (on plants ordered while your membership is active)
- 10% member pricing on pots and accessories
- Early access to rare plant drops

One thing to know: Express shipping isn't free with Leafy Plus. It's $14.95 for everyone.

If you sign up and change your mind, you can get a full refund if you cancel within **14 days** of purchase or renewal and haven't used any member benefits.

Is there anything else I can help you with? We're always happy to chat. 🌱
